lines: No craze can catch him, though minds craze, far feet
ne'er gain his bourne, hard wold at evenfall: praise Mild.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhramo na labhyate yasya bhrāntāntaḥkaraṇair api dūragair api yasyānto durgam astaṃ stumo mṛḍam

reads_against.argmap: No delusion is found of him even by deluded hearts.; Even by far-goers his end — impassable setting — we praise Mṛḍa. → We praise Mṛḍa, errorless and reachless.
c1_essence: Power-creeper blooming as gods protects; Mṛḍa errorless, reachless, praised everywhere.
reads_against.l2: Deluded hearts find no delusion in him; far-rangers never reach his end — hard ground at dusk: Mṛḍa we praise.
